content:
The City of Laredo celebrated the ribbon cutting of the Laredo Fire Department Health & Wellness Center on Friday, a new facility dedicated to the well-being of the city's firefighters and first responders.

The center represents a commitment to the physical, mental, and emotional well-being of first responders, made possible through an investment by the Mayor and City Council.

Mayor Dr. Victor D. Treviño and District 5 Council Member Ruben Gutierrez attended the ribbon cutting.

Update — Friday, Nov. 6: KGNS reports the new center, which opened Friday next to the main fire station on Del Mar Boulevard, includes a gym, access to a psychologist, a dedicated room for peer-support meetings, a telehealth area for clinical services and a 24-hour support system staffed by fellow firefighters trained to understand the job's challenges. Department psychologist Dr. Gina Dunckel is part of the center's team, according to KGNS. The center follows a 2024 proposal to create a wellness facility for local first responders.

Sources: City of Laredo; KGNS.
